newsitem.title: GERMANY: AVA sees 1997 group sales up eight pct.
newsitem.headline: AVA sees 1997 group sales up eight pct.

text.p: German retail group AVA AG said on Thursday it expected improved sales in the first five months of 1997 to lead group sales for the full year in an eight percent rise to 11.7 billion marks.
From January to May, sales of AVA companies increased 5.1 percent to 3.7 billion marks, chief executive Klaus Daudel said. The figure does not include the Nanz group, AVA's Stutgart-based affiliate.
Earlier on Thursday, AVA, whose full name is Allgemeine Handelsgesellschaft der Verbraucher AG, said 1997 group net income would be about equal to the 29 million marks reported last year.
AVA expected 56 million marks in costs related to an increase in its Nanz stake to 49.5 percent from 9.5 percent.
In the first quarter AVA group sales rose 12.1 percent to 2.3 billion marks, while Nanz sales rose 4.5 percent to 559 million marks.
